scripts.fmt: bun fmt --no-script astro.config.mjs package.json tsconfig.json wrangler.jsonc scripts src/data src/lib src/styles src/worker.ts src/worker.test.ts
scripts.fmt:check: bun fmt --no-script --check astro.config.mjs package.json tsconfig.json wrangler.jsonc scripts src/data src/lib src/styles src/worker.ts src/worker.test.ts
scripts.wrangler:dry-run: bash -euo pipefail -c 'out=$(mktemp -d /tmp/komawm-wrangler-dry-run.XXXXXX); trap "rm -rf $out" EXIT; WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false ./node_modules/.bin/wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir "$out"'
scripts.check: bun run sync:manual:if-available && bun run fmt:check && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run validate:dist && bun run wrangler:dry-run
